authority: Current user choices: EEEEE 1k 1/2 W 5% carbon through-hole R8, minimal carrier passives, fitted PTT, direct amplifier speaker wiring and concise CAD annotations.

speaker.connection: Direct external insulated wires to U3 amplifier SPK+ and SPK- terminals

ptt.selection: Normally-open tactile switch, nominal 6 x 6 x 8 mm
ptt.geometry_status: Four pads adopt a 6.5 x 4.5 mm reference pattern. Logical1 duplicates across one 6.5mm pair; logical2 duplicates across the other. Physical fit and contact pairing of the selected OCR/Amazon switch remain unverified.
ptt.connection: GPIO39 / U1 J3_10 directly to PTT_N / SW1 contact1; contact2 to GND
ptt.firmware: Unchanged: ENABLE_PTT=false. Existing enabled code uses GPIO39 INPUT_PULLUP; validate debounce and LOW-when-pressed behavior when enabled.

microphone_data_pulldown.population: No added carrier microphone SD pulldown
microphone_data_pulldown.evidence_limit: Module pulldown/bypass population requires physical inspection. L/R is grounded.

provisional_choices: Header center 2 mm above body bottom
1.1 mm carrier finished holes and 1.8 mm pads pending actual pin fit
amplifier.representation: U3 remains a physical daughterboard mounted on carrier JAMP1; U3 logical symbol is excluded from PCB so speaker output terminals do not invent carrier pads

requirements.ELEC_PTT_N: U1 J3_10 GPIO39 connects directly to fitted SW1 logical contact1/PTT_N; contact2 is GND.
requirements.ELEC_SPEAKER: LS1 wires directly to U3 SPK+/SPK-. Neither output is GND; the carrier has no speaker connector or mounting area.
requirements.ELEC_MIC_PULLDOWN: No additional carrier SD pulldown; use existing microphone module circuitry. L/R is grounded.
requirements.MECH_MODULES: Use researched reference U2 footprint with14mm body,2.54mm columns,7.62mm rows and3mm central NPTH; use four-leg SW1 reference6.5x4.5 contact geometry. Both are candidate patterns pending owned-part fit. JAMP1 models7 amplifier carrier contacts at image-supported2.54 pitch; header/body datum,drill and pin fit remain provisional. U3/LS1 logical symbols are excluded from PCB.
requirements.MECH_FIT: 70x90mm carrier; reference module/switch/resistor clearances require physical verification. Speaker mounting is external.
requirements.FAB_CLEARANCE: Logic0.25width/0.20clearance, mic3V3 0.50/0.20, amp5V1.00/0.25; copper-edge0.50. Speaker output nets have no carrier copper.
requirements.ROUTE_SPEAKER: No speaker outputs route through the carrier. Direct external paired leads attach only to amplifier SPK+/SPK- terminals, stay clear of microphone and mechanical hazards, and never connect to GND.
requirements.ASSEMBLY: Fit modules, JAMP1, EEEEE R8 1k / 1/2 W / 5% carbon axial through-hole and SW1. Mount R8 horizontally with 15.24 mm formed pitch after confirming owned-part fit. Speaker wires directly to amplifier. Preserve test pads and mounting hardware; no carrier capacitors or removable links.
requirements.ELEC_DIRECT_CONNECTIONS: All I2S, shutdown, PTT and power paths use direct copper.
requirements.ELEC_BYPASS: No carrier capacitors. Existing module bypassing remains; inspect population and rail behavior during hardware validation.
requirements.LABELS: Keep useful component, pin, supply and orientation labels; remove stale DNP, optional-part and iteration instructions. Keep schematic notes concise.
requirements.ELEC_PTT_POPULATION: SW1 is fitted; its normally-open contact connects GPIO39/PTT_N to GND.
requirements.MECH_R8: R8 adopts a 10.0 x 3.6 mm body envelope, 15.24 mm horizontal formed pitch, 1.0 mm drills and 2.0 mm pads. Confirm actual EEEEE body, lead diameter and board clearance before assembly; no exact owned-part mechanical drawing is established.
requirements.VIEWS_3D: Separate top, bottom and isometric assembled PNGs, plus one combined PNG showing all three.

microphone_reference.source_kind: Community-authored CAD, not a manufacturer drawing for the owned SKU
microphone_reference.orientation: Acoustic/solder face up; upper row SCK/WS/LR, lower row SD/VDD/GND. Community reference rotated180degrees, not mirrored.
microphone_reference.carrier_interconnect_choices: 1.1mm drill and1.8mm pad are engineering choices, changed from reference0.762/1.524 for pin-fit margin; actual pins still require verification.
microphone_reference.mechanical_assumption: 3mm module standoff is a planning assumption; check underside can and solder protrusions.
microphone_reference.physical_fit_status: Reference geometry is routed; exact owned module pitch, terminal identities, face orientation and acoustic alignment must be checked at1:1.

carrier_passives.R8: EEEEE 1 kohm, 1/2 W, 5% carbon axial through-hole amplifier SD/MODE pulldown

resistor.function: Single AMP_SD / SD_MODE to GND pulldown
resistor.geometry_basis: Conservative horizontal reference; Royal Ohm half-watt carbon-film drawing is not an exact EEEEE specification.
resistor.physical_fit_status: Actual owned body length/diameter, lead diameter and formed-pitch fit remain unmeasured.
resistor.model_status: Authored representative geometry, not EEEEE manufacturer CAD
